name: LinkShortener.io
summary: Branded short links and dynamic QR codes with click reports by country and device, link-in-bio pages and your own domain on paid plans.
best_for: marketers and small teams who want branded short links and dynamic QR codes with click reports, and who are fine staying within a monthly link allowance
skip_if: you need an API to create links from your own software, you create thousands of links a month on a small budget, or you want a product we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: The Free plan allows only 20 links or QR codes a month and no custom domain. Changing where a live link points needs Pro at $34 a month. The pricing page says there is no public API on any plan.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic · Basic $13 a month or $130 a year (350 links or QR codes a month, 1 custom domain)
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-12 on linkshortener.io/pricing, US dollars) LinkShortener.io has a Free plan and three paid plans, each with a shared monthly allowance of short links and QR codes. Free costs $0 for 20 a month on the shared tli.sh domain and needs an account but no card. Basic costs $13 a month, or $130 a year, for 350 a month and 1 custom domain. Pro costs $34 a month, or $340 a year, for 2,000 a month and 3 custom domains. Elite costs $260 a month, or $2,600 a year, for 5,000 a month, 10 custom domains and a dedicated account manager. Enterprise has no listed price and covers unlimited volume, SSO and white-label options. The page says clicks and scans are never billed and no plan has overage fees: when you reach your monthly allowance, existing links keep working and new links wait until the allowance renews or you upgrade. Yearly billing is shown as two months free. We did not open the sign-up flow, so the tax added is not known.
